title: Moreira's version of Sard's theorem
abstract: Formalizes Moreira's strengthening of Sard's theorem, bounding the Hausdorff dimension of critical-value images of C^{k+alpha} maps.

informal.hausdorffMeasure_sardMoreiraBound_image_: Proves Hausdorff-measure nullity for images of points where the derivative rank is bounded by p, at Moreira's Sard bound.
informal.dimH_image_le_sardMoreiraBound_of_finran: Converts the measure-null theorem into the headline Hausdorff-dimension upper bound for critical-value images.
